title: Prabha Netlist
description: Shape of a wiring graph: instantiated blocks + connections between their ports. Used both as a top-level .prabha design and, nested, as a compound block's internal subnetlist. Relational checks (do refs/ports exist, kind/fs match, cycles) are ENGINE validation, not schema.

id.description: Instance id, unique within this netlist.

ref.description: Id of the block DEFINITION this instantiates (resolved by the engine).

params.description: Overrides of the block definition's default params. Validated against that block's param schema by the engine, not here.
